cohort: A cohort of 327 patients, including those with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus, for whom various neonatal and perinatal factors were analyzed to predict T1D risk.
finding: An artificial neural network (ANN) model successfully predicted Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus risk with high accuracy (84.2%) by integrating neonatal and perinatal factors.
mod_finding: Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus patients showed a higher incidence of cesarean deliveries, and delivery type was weakly positively correlated with birth weight, birth weight class, and nutrition type.
